howUsed: Discovery directory only. We read the 'Art & Design' table and selected services that are no-key, HTTPS and CORS-friendly.

selectedServices.name: Art Institute of Chicago
selectedServices.integration: server/references.mjs: read-only, keyless search proxy with in-memory caching (6h TTL, 240 queries max), strict image-id validation, disk-cached thumbnail proxy (max 900 KB, 9000 ms timeout). Used by /inspiration. No API key required; museum links open on artic.edu.

notUsed: No other listed service is integrated. No code, artwork, data exports, or API keys from the repository were copied. The README itself is not vendored; only its LICENSE is retained for notice completeness.
boundaries: Museum references are never converted into products, prices, orders, or reviews.
If the museum API is unreachable, the shelf degrades to an honest offline note; the store is unaffected.
README is a community list — the integration honors api.artic.edu's own terms, not the list's claims.
